concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-netsuite-set-up-point-of-sale]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured SCIS in-person setup guide for ordered bundles, merchant/store mapping, Terminal API credentials and roles, NetSuite POS profile/device IDs, Standard webhook and Terminal API event URLs; settings do not prove a terminal or bank outcome.
warnings: The guide's production-endpoint-prefix example contains a test-looking URL; verify actual environment URL and Test Mode before configuration.
Credential, webhook and device setup are separate steps and no successful payment, order, refund or settlement is evidenced.
